meta.title: Padel System Academy — All-inclusive padel experiences in the Maresme
meta.description: Weekend clinics and intensive 4-day stages with accommodation, meals and up to 30 hours of padel training. Limited spots.

weekend.name: Weekend clinic
weekend.summary: Saturday and Sunday of themed clinics to sharpen your game.

stage.name: Intensive stage
stage.summary: Friday to Monday: full immersion to level up your game.

hero.title: Train like a pro. Live it as an experience.
hero.subtitle: All-inclusive packs: accommodation, meals and up to 30 hours of padel with the PS method. All you have to do is play.

includes.title: What every experience includes
includes.padelText: Small-group training, from 8 to 30 hours depending on the pack, with a plan built around you.
includes.stayText: You sleep close to the courts. Arrive, drop your bag and play.
includes.mealsText: Menus designed for athletes, so you perform all day long.
includes.trackingText: An initial assessment, clear goals and a final report so you keep improving at home.

method.title: A system, not a course
method.intro: Every experience follows the same four steps. That is why the academy is called System.
method.s1Text: On day one we analyse your game on court: technique, positioning and decision-making.
method.s2Text: We set 2 or 3 specific goals and tailor every session to your level.
method.s3Text: Technical, tactical and match-play blocks in small groups, with constant feedback.
method.s4Text: You leave with a summary of your progress and drills to keep working at home.

faq.title: Before you book
faq.a1: None in particular. We have packs from beginner to competition level and group players by level.
faq.q2: Can I come on my own?
faq.a2: Of course. We place you in a group at your level, so you don't need a partner.
faq.q3: Can I bring a companion who doesn't play?
faq.a3: Yes. Add the non-playing companion extra, with accommodation and meals included.
faq.a4: Send us a request with your pack and date. We reply personally to confirm your spot and the details.
faq.q5: Where do the experiences take place?
faq.a5: In the Maresme, between El Masnou and Montgat, near Barcelona. We confirm the exact venue for each date when you book.

finalCta.title: Limited spots every weekend. Book yours.
finalCta.subtitle: Groups of max. 4 players. When they're full, they're full.
